title: GTA6 Locked at 30fps on PS5? Media Poll Sparks Community Debate
description: Recent reports from Push Square confirm Rockstar Games has set a 30fps target for GTA6 on PS5 and PS5 Pro, sparking massive debate among fans.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Framerate Confirmed: Does a 30fps Lock on PS5 Ruin the Experience?

Your potential nightmare has become a reality: Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA6) runs at just 30 frames-per-second on both the standard PlayStation 5 and the enhanced PlayStation 5 Pro.

According to reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, this target frame rate was confirmed earlier today by Rockstar Games itself. The announcement has prompted an outpouring of relative disappointment from players who were banking on a silky 60fps experience on Sony's current-generation hardware.

### The Community Reaction and Poll

The gaming community has long debated the hardware limits of current-generation consoles. Following the release of the PS5 Pro, many fans held high hopes that the upgraded hardware would finally bridge the gap, enabling a 60fps mode for Rockstar's monumental open-world title. However, with the developer confirming a 30fps target, those expectations have been met with a reality check.

In response to the news, Push Square launched a public poll asking players a crucial question: Is GTA6 being stuck at 30fps on PS5 a dealbreaker? The early responses highlight a divided player base:

- **The Fidelity Advocates:** Some players argue that Rockstar Games has always prioritized pushing the boundaries of graphics, massive NPC density, and intricate physics over high frame rates. For them, a 30fps lock is a small price to pay for unprecedented visual fidelity.
- **The Performance Purists:** On the other hand, many core gamers who have grown accustomed to smooth 60fps or higher gameplay find 30fps harder to swallow on modern hardware, expressing frustration over the hardware limitations.

### Context and Industry Perspective

Looking back at Rockstar's development history, titles like Red Dead Redemption 2 also launched targeting 30fps in order to maximize open-world detail and cinematic presentation. GTA6 is expected to push hardware constraints even further, meaning that locking the frame rate may be a necessary technical compromise to ensure stability and graphical grandeur.

While the confirmation might sting for performance enthusiasts, it underscores the massive technological scale of what Rockstar is attempting to build.

### Editor's Take

While a 30fps lock is undeniably disappointing for fans accustomed to high-framerate gaming, it aligns with Rockstar's tradition of prioritizing visual depth and world complexity. Ultimately, whether this technical target serves as a dealbreaker will depend on individual player preferences when the game finally arrives.
